# SoftNexa Solutions

> SoftNexa is a full-stack digital product engineering, enterprise software consultancy, and AI automation partner built for fast-moving companies that outgrew spreadsheets and generic off-the-shelf tools.

## Core Services
- **Custom Business Software & ERP**: End-to-end bespoke enterprise platforms, manufacturing execution systems (MES), inventory & warehouse management, multi-branch point of sale, and operational workflows with real-time audit trails.
- **Web Applications & High-Performance SaaS**: Multi-tenant architectures, subscription billing, customer self-service portals, scalable APIs, and real-time collaborative dashboards.
- **Mobile Applications**: Cross-platform Flutter and React Native mobile apps for iOS and Android, offline-first sync, push notifications, and hardware integrations.
- **AI Automation & Intelligent Workflows**: Autonomous LLM agents, document parsing (OCR/receipts/invoices), automated lead intake, sentiment analysis, and intelligent bot integrations.
- **Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps**: CI/CD pipelines, Docker containerization, AWS / Google Cloud / DigitalOcean architectures, automated zero-downtime deployments, and ISO-grade security hardening.
- **Product Design & Prototyping**: Interactive Figma prototypes, high-conversion UI/UX design systems, user journey mapping, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).

## Key Differentiators & Guarantees
- **Fixed-Price Guarantee**: Guaranteed fixed delivery cost and verified schedule. No runaway hourly billing.
- **Architectural Discovery & Scope**: Comprehensive technical blueprint, wireframes, and delivery roadmap provided within 48 hours.
- **Engineering-First Communication**: Direct access to senior architects and engineers with replies within one business day.

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: Modern Responsive HTML5, JavaScript (ES6+), React, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS.
- Backend: PHP 8.x, Python, Node.js, RESTful & GraphQL APIs, microservices.
- Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB.
- Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Nginx, Linux, AWS, Google Cloud, Cloudflare, SSL/TLS.
